definitions.gloss: attendee; guest (at a ceremony such as a wedding or funeral)
definitions.explanation: A person present at a formal ceremony such as a wedding, funeral, or memorial. Used in formal contexts; the everyday word for a guest is ゲスト or お{客|きゃく}さん.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参列者|さんれつしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There were a hundred guests at the wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参列者|さんれつしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I greeted the attendees of the funeral.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{新郎新婦|しんろうしんぷ}→新郎新婦：28965_shinroushinpu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{参列者|さんれつしゃ}⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: After the ceremony, the bride and groom thanked each guest one by one.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧ (attendance at a ceremony) + 〜⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers specifically to those attending a formal ceremony, not just any gathering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参列者|さんれつしゃ}: wedding guests
- ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参列者|さんれつしゃ}: funeral attendees
- {参列者|さんれつしゃ}⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧: list of attendees
- {参列者|さんれつしゃ}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all the attendees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出席者|しゅっせきしゃ}→出席者：20975_shussekisha⟧: attendee — broader; used for meetings, classes, conferences
- ⟦{来賓|らいひん}→来賓：28580_raihin⟧: invited guest of honor — VIPs at formal events
- {会葬者|かいそうしゃ}: funeral attendee — more specific to funerals only
